usedFor: AgentX holds your conversations and Google Docs holds the log that “Add or Replace Text In Tab” writes.

bestTemplate.name: “New Conversation” in AgentX, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new conversation is written into a doc tab, so you keep a running record of chats.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace the tab's existing text, so choose add, not replace.
